identity.message: RCO Identity 2.0.6: the saved appearance comes back after a revive (no more missing head), /coat works over MP shirts, and male pieces with no model were removed (Left Ring 5, Wrist Binding 6, MP Accessories 6, 14, 39, 42, 50, 61).

vehicles.message: RCO Vehicles 0.1.102: lock your car with L (cars only): nobody gets in while it is locked, the owner sees Lock/Unlock beside the seat prompts and a padlock on the speedometer, everyone near hears it; a player back after a crash gets his vehicles that are still out (map icons, lock) again. Also in 0.1.100-0.1.101: vehicle type tabs at the dealer, aircraft gauge and airfield shown only while the aircraft resource runs, unflipping resumes after a fall.
